The route closed against the nominal 0.2 T boundary (~516 ps + L allowed per input), so the 512-bit S capture row was never sized for 190 ps. b3: io_budget in 0.6 / out 0.57 T (route + sign-off enforce native capture/launch), output hold pads kept (b3 trial without them 285867c4f: GPL-0305 divergence at gate), benches on the production --qb-pinread. RTL, outline 142.56 x 86.4, pins unchanged. | NEW master (S-ELEM-PQ/LEGACY 2026-10-16, ROOT GAP 1): ot_s81_pq_qb_bankp_native is the QB SRAM bank of the canonical PQ hierarchy (OT_PQ_QB_PIPE + OT_PQ_QB_PHYS_SPLIT, tools/s81/pq_native_hierarchy.py), x4 in both ot_s81_pq_qb_pipe_native and ot_s81_pq_qb_pinread_native (P10 headpc); it had no kit. Same 142.56x86.4 footprint and S aq_q / N rd / W control faces as the legacy bank0..3 slot (no new footprint); one 128x256 1R1W SRAM; every pin registered in RTL (capture + output register = the canonical +2). | b2: b1 gate (038cb3a78) floorplan showed rd packed into ~15 um at the N-W corner, aq_q in two corner clusters on S and clk near the SW corner -> explicit even per-face spread (spread_face_pins.py; clk at the W-face centre). Util 37% WARN kept on purpose: the outline is set by the 94.8x41.1 SRAM plus the 20 um macro channels to the two wide pin faces (N rd 256, S aq_q 512); it is the existing legacy bank0..3 die slot (drop-in, no new footprint).
